verdict.rationale: Undermind documents uploading PDFs to a workspace: paywalled PDFs can be read after upload. It can also search papers already in the workspace and run parallel full-text Q&A across many papers, so researching over your own PDFs is supported. However, upload is framed only as a way to read paywalled papers, not as ingestion of an arbitrary personal corpus, and the deep-research agent is described as searching the global literature. Missing for 10: explicit support for uploading arbitrary documents or a whole corpus, documentation that the deep-research agent can be scoped to uploaded files only, and hands-on or community corroboration of upload-based research.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can upload my own PDFs or corpus and have the agent research over them

citations.quote: paywalled PDFs can be read after workspace upload.
Searches the global literature, papers already in the workspace, or a paper’s references and citations in seconds.
Reads full-text PDFs in parallel and answers specific questions across many papers at once, including from figures, tables, and equations.
Unlimited workspaces, files, and paper libraries
